listings.thesis: Another direct proxy for the large and growing pharmaceutical component of the human consumption basket.
listings.note: Defensive consumption proxy, but lower alpha because the basket is consensus, mature, and already institutionally owned.

priorCase.rankRationale: Carbon-based human-consumption basket: Novartis remains a mature, consensus, institutionally-owned pharma proxy. Pipeline/M&A items predate June 9 and don't add residual alpha to this silicon-vs-carbon lens. Hold at 5, 0.
